title: Enraged 24-Year-Old Storms Into Ex-Fiancé’s House And Lights Bible On Fire
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On June 25th, 2023. Officers received a call from a man regarding his ex-fiancee who had broken into his home and started vandalizing his property and also setting a bible on fire at his doorstep.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
